description: This file implements an independent chunked encoding parser used by HttpParser, including functions for parsing chunk sizes, consuming hex numbers, and iterating over chunks.

classes.name: uWS::ChunkIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing chunks in the chunked encoding stream.

methods.name: uWS::chunkSize
methods.description: Extracts the size of the current chunk from the state.

methods.name: uWS::consumeHexNumber
methods.description: Reads a hexadecimal number from data and updates the parser state.

methods.name: uWS::decChunkSize
methods.description: Decreases the current chunk size in the parser state.

methods.name: uWS::hasChunkSize
methods.description: Checks if the parser state indicates a chunk size is present.

methods.name: uWS::isParsingChunkedEncoding
methods.description: Determines if the parser is currently parsing chunked encoding.

methods.name: uWS::isParsingInvalidChunkedEncoding
methods.description: Checks if the parser state indicates an error in chunked encoding.

methods.name: uWS::getNextChunk
methods.description: Retrieves the next data chunk from the stream based on the current parser state.
